verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an API service, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a single secret api_key passed with requests, plus a community note that the MCP server accepts Bearer auth. Neither shows scoped, restricted or per-agent keys, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
